scope: Local exact-E production-API allocation stages plus source-only owner/caller audit. Not actual Linux step_udp allocation totals or elapsed-time evidence.

probe.runtime: Local Apple AArch64, Rust1.98.1, exactE release library, System wrapper counts only. Reuses standalone counting pattern from loop_owner_screen.rs; setup/priming/printing excluded.
probe.query: q0000.m6a.test A and q0007.m6a.test AAAA; frozen loadgen format,32B packet,16B wire name,14B dotted name,noOPT;800 primed cache entries,A/AAAA70/30.

counts_each_query.copies: 16 expanded name bytes into temporary Vec,then discarded
16 expanded wire-name bytes retained for answer

concrete_small_opportunity: Initial inspect materializes a name only to test parse error. Using the existing exact walk_name validation path could remove1allocation/32requestedB and16copiednameB per ordinary hit without carrying parsed ownership across layers. Not implemented or timed.
edns_scans: Ordinary no-config-EDNS UDP cache hit calls find_pseudoheader in query_metadata(true),client_subnet_cacheable(false),local lookup(true),cache answer(true):four nonallocating scans. At most three repeated scans might be reusable only after preserving each caller signing and malformed-section behavior; no speedup bound is claimed.

C_source_comparison.receive: forward.c1581–1668 uses daemon packet scratch and zeros its unreceivedtail;1880+ obtains pseudoheader,1930+ calls add_edns0_config and blockdata_alloc(saved query),then answer_request. C is not assumed to perform zero per-query allocations.
C_source_comparison.answer: rfc1035.c1693+ uses daemon.namebuff and writes into the existing packet after the question;cache.c1174+ returns existing chain nodes and applies expiry/LRU/rotation without an owned Vec of IDs. blockdata allocation/reuse costs are not measured here.

error_constraints: Keep opcodeNOTIMP before extract_requestREFUSED and unskippable-question drop. validate_name follows compression pointers and rejects unsupportedlabeltypes/loops; skip_name is not equivalent.

Keep originalpacket metadata before decoration; false/true signing scans differ for nonQUERY/TKEY/TSIG and error replies. Local lookup treats invalidadditional as noOPT while cache may propagate a WireError.
Do not skip local/CNAME/negative/lease checks,cacheLRU/expiry/rotation or send-before-stalerefresh. Empty lease/interface/config collections do not justify workload-specific bypasses.
limits: Old loop_owner_screen 10alloc/538B was a host-record local-answer fixture; it is not this dynamic-cache hit.
No actual full Linux owner counter was run in this task. Metrics/socket/poll/send outside these public stages are source-audited only.
Dotted14B,singleton64B andreply128B are existing ownership/API costs,not free removable allocations.
No Oracle/router workload or product change was performed for this audit.
